_note: Pinned against kasm-session-runtime's v0.2.0-rc.3 tag (a pre-release verification tag, not a stable release -- stable releases are still hard-disabled in that repo's .gitlab-ci.yml pending review). This tag is the rename to kasm-session-runtime (from kasm-session-agent) and the sdk/ package split -- binary name, module path, and every KASM_AGENT_* env var changed; nothing consumed the old names yet, so this re-pin carries no compat shim. Hashes computed by downloading both published objects directly (curl) and taking sha256-<base64 of the raw SHA-256 digest> -- the same value nix's own fixed-output derivation check computes for a fetchurl, verified against a live, publicly-readable object (kasm-labs-sandbox.s3.eu-north-1.amazonaws.com), not fabricated or copied from a fakeHash mismatch message. Re-pin against a real release the same way once the stable-tag gate is lifted: download both kasm-session-runtime-linux-<amd64|arm64>.<tag>.<short-commit> objects, sha256 + base64 each, update commit_id/branch/hashes here.
